title: The NFL Chapter Is Over: Russell Wilson Announces Retirement After Historic Career - NewsBreak
text:
By Grace L. ,
5 hours ago The NFL is losing one of its most recognizable quarterbacks of the past decade, but Russell Wilson’s exit comes with a legacy that remains as debated as it is accomplished. Wilson officially announced his retirement Wednesday, ending a 14-year NFL career that included a Super Bowl championship, 10 Pro Bowl selections, nearly 47,000 passing yards, and a reputation for consistently finding himself at the center of football conversations. While reports earlier this week indicated the veteran quarterback was preparing to retire and move into broadcasting, Wilson confirmed the decision himself through a heartfelt social media video addressed to the game that shaped his life.
